chunks: It is not permissible for him to have relations with the bondwoman of his daughter except with her permission.

key_terms.لَا يَجُوزُ: it is not permissible under the law

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a man to have relations with his daughter's bondwoman without her permission?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that prohibits a man from having relations with his daughter's bondwoman unless the daughter gives permission. It highlights the recognition of her authority and rights in matters connected to her bondwoman.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "It is not permissible for a man to have relations with the bondwoman of his daughter except with her permission."
